title: DevForgeAI Ideation Inception PM-Plan Output Contract
description: JSON Schema (v1.0) for the inception Project-Management plan produced by spec-driven-ideation (the PM phase). The future spec-driven-architecture-* skills consume this contract. The structured data lives in the YAML frontmatter of devforgeai/specs/requirements/{project}-requirements.md; this schema is the published, versioned contract that inoculates the PM->Architecture seam against the format-drift class of defect documented in the ideation modernization plan. additionalProperties is true at object level for forward-compatibility.

risk.description: A risk carried into build/sprint planning. Mirrors the brainstorm risk_analysis.risks[] shape; carried verbatim when a brainstorm is present, elicited during Phase 03 otherwise.

stakeholder.description: A project stakeholder with influence/interest and RACI. Sourced from the brainstorm stakeholders.registry[] when present, merged with ideation personas.

requirement.description: A prioritized functional requirement with MoSCoW priority.

roadmap_phase.description: A milestone in the phased release roadmap (e.g. MVP / Release 2 / Future). Carries build order and dependencies but NO schedule durations, resource loading, or budget breakdown - those are ungrounded at the inception PM stage.

items.description: Requirement ids or capability names included in this milestone.

dependencies.description: Build-order dependencies - milestone names or requirement ids this phase depends on.

assumption.description: An assumption that, if invalidated, becomes a downstream defect. Sourced from the brainstorm assumptions register and ideation elicitation.

deferred_idea.description: An idea raised but intentionally not in the current MVP - referenced from the standalone idea-backlog artifact (DEF-NNN shape).

schema_version.description: Ideation-output contract version. Const 1.0 for this schema file.

created.description: ISO 8601 date the PM plan was generated.

source_brainstorm.description: Back-reference to the originating brainstorm (BRAINSTORM-NNN), or null when ideation ran with no brainstorm input.

scope_baseline.description: The locked scope boundary: what is in, out, and deferred to future.

milestone_roadmap.description: Phased release roadmap with build order and dependencies. Sourced from the brainstorm release_roadmap when present, derived from MoSCoW + scope.future otherwise.

risk_register.description: RISK-NNN register carried into build/sprint planning.

stakeholder_register.description: Stakeholders with influence, interest, and RACI / decision authority.

constraints.description: Technical, business, regulatory, and resource constraints that must be followed.

idea_backlog_ref.description: Relative path to the standalone living idea-backlog artifact (devforgeai/specs/ideation/{project}-idea-backlog.md). The full DEF-NNN items live in that file; this contract carries only the reference.

idea_backlog_preview.description: Optional inline preview of the idea backlog (DEF-NNN items). The idea-backlog file remains the source of truth.
